tool_input.command:
cat >> backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py <<'EOF'


def test_delete_item_description(
    client: TestClient, superuser_token_headers: dict[str, str], db: Session
) -> None:
    item = create_random_item(db)
    response = client.delete(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/{item.id}/description",
        headers=superuser_token_headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK
    content = response.json()
    assert content["id"] == str(item.id)
    assert content["title"] == item.title
    assert content["description"] is None
    db.refresh(item)
    assert item.description is None


def test_delete_item_description_not_found(
    client: TestClient, superuser_token_headers: dict[str, str]
) -> None:
    response = client.delete(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/{uuid.uuid4()}/description",
        headers=superuser_token_headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
    content = response.json()
    assert content["detail"] == "Item not found"


def test_delete_item_description_not_enough_permissions(
    client: TestClient, normal_user_token_headers: dict[str, str], db: Session
) -> None:
    item = create_random_item(db)
    response = client.delete(
        f"{settings.API_V1_STR}/items/{item.id}/description",
        headers=normal_user_token_headers,
    )
    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
    content = response.json()
    assert content["detail"] == "Not enough permissions"
    db.refresh(item)
    assert item.description is not None
EOF
sed -i '' '1,5{s/^from fastapi.testclient import TestClient$/from fastapi import status\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient/;}' backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py && head -8 backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py && git status --short && git diff --stat

I added `DELETE /api/v1/items/{id}/description`. It clears the item's description and returns the updated item. Nothing was run, per your instruction. I did not run the tests, the app, or the lint hook beyond the edit-time checks.

**Changes**

- **`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`**: new `delete_item_description` handler, `response_model=ItemPublic`.
  - Returns 404 "Item not found" when the item doesn't exist.
  - Returns 403 "Not enough permissions" unless the caller is the owner or a superuser. This matches the existing item endpoints rather than the 404-hiding option in `docs/security.md`.
- **`backend/app/crud.py`**: `get_item` and `clear_item_description`. The second sets `description` to `None`, commits, and refreshes. I put the database access here because `backend/app/CLAUDE.md` says route handlers don't call session methods.
- **`backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`**: three tests covering clearing as superuser, 404, and 403 for a non-owner. The 403 test also checks the description is unchanged.

**Lint hook**

The edit hook flagged the numeric status codes in my first version. I switched the new handler to `status.HTTP_*` constants. The existing handlers in `items.py` still use numbers, and I left them alone.
